mapper.select: SELECT id, name, access_key_id, access_key_secret, region, bucket, endpoint, custom_domain, key_prefix, remark, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM t_storage_config ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, access_key_id, access_key_secret, region, bucket, endpoint, custom_domain, key_prefix, remark, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM t_storage_config WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_storage_config (name, access_key_id, access_key_secret, region, bucket, endpoint, custom_domain, key_prefix, remark, updated_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{accessKeyId}, #{accessKeySecret}, #{region}, #{bucket}, #{endpoint}, #{customDomain}, #{keyPrefix}, #{remark}, #{updatedBy})
